newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Venezuela faces fiscal challenge - IADB's Hausmann.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela faces fiscal challenge - IADB's Hausmann.

text.p: Venezuela faces a challenge in the near future of managing the fiscal consequences of a coming appreciation of the real exchange rate, said Ricardo Hausmann, chief economist at the Inter-American Development Bank (IADB).
Hausmann, speaking to Reuters late Monday at a seminar in Brasilia on public finances, added Venezuela "was on track".
The IADB economist said an exchange rate appreciation will pressure the government's oil export revenue in domestic terms.
He said Venezuela's fiscal accounts were doing well now following its "massive" devaluation of the Bolivar currency and relatively high current oil prices.

"As inflation erodes the depreciation and oil prices return to more normal levels, the challenge will be to manage the fiscal consequences," he said. "Real appreciation will deteriorate the fiscal accounts."
